title: Prospective multicentre registry for children and adolescents with a relapsed/refractory haematological neoplasia, solid extracranial or CNS tumour as part of the promotion of the establishment of a network entitled “PECT-EAST” for the implementation of early clinical studies in paediatric oncology in the federal states of Berlin, Brandenburg, Mecklenburg- Vorpommern and Sachsen
summary: Prospective demographic survey of paediatric patients with relapsed/refractory haematological neoplasms, solid extracranial tumours and CNS tumours in the federal states of Berlin, Brandenburg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Sachsen
conditions: relapsed and refractory paediatric patients with haematological neoplasia, solid extracranial and CNS tumours

interventions.name: Prospective demographic survey of paediatric patients with relapsed/refractory haematological neoplasms, solid extracranial tumours and CNS tumours in the federal states of Berlin, Brandenburg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Sachsen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All paediatric patients with relapsed/refractory haematological neoplasia, solid extracranial or CNS tumours living in the federal states of Berlin, Brandenburg, Mecklenburg- Vorpommern and Sachsen up to the age of 0-25 years can be included.
Exclusion criteria:
There are no exclusion criteria.
